d: Port of Seeland. On one side the tower of the lighthouse, and the house of Guido. On the other side the inn of the "Vaccello admiral" (Vaccello admiral).Corrado, Scudieri, Guido and Arrigo.
Metilde leaving Guido's house. Then Rogiero, Corrado, Scudieri, Adelina, Arrigo, Damigelle and Guido.
Rustano comes in a boat with a few sailors who pull the gomene of Gianni's ship. He descends to the ground, and piles the rope singing.
When the ship enters the port, the Marinai begin to descend. Finally Gianni, Guido and Rustano.
Gianni, Rustano, finally Uffiziali and Popolo.
Royal gardens. Adelina. Then Metilde with his son. Finally Rustano.
The King, Rogiero, an Officer and the Scudieri; Adelina, Arrigo and the Damigelle. Then Gianni and Metilde with his son. Finally Corrado.
Night. Atrium adjacent to a garden. They rust wrapped in a cloak. So Corrado with people disguised. Finally Rogiero.
Corrado, his people, Rustano as a sailor. Finally Metilde with the Son.
Inside the palace. Adelina with her damsel. Then Metilde with the Son. Finally the King followed by Gianni, Rustano, Scudieri and Guards.
